ending: Malcolm is defeated, arrested, and publicly discredited after Anna, Damien, and Sebastien expose his financial crimes and staged dealings with the Raven Queen. The textile subcommission goes forward, leaving Sebastien with gold, shareholder papers, and a four-percent stake that can free her from dangerous side work. Oliver and the Verdant Stag survive the Architects of Kronos assault, but Knave Knoll, valuable property, and many defenders are lost. The real stolen book remains secure, and Katerine confirms that both copies of Siobhan's bloodprint vow have been destroyed. Tanya survives after helping Siobhan escape capture, though her loyalties and knowledge remain uncertain. Liza can oppose renewed blood scrying only at great cost, and the sleep-proxy spell remains viable but potentially lethal and ethically compromised. Newton remains dead, while the Red Guard's alteration of his family's memories destroys Sebastien's remaining trust in official institutions. Siobhan leaves Oliver without confronting him, resolved to verify whether he exploited her stolen-book predicament as cover for another secret. Thaddeus Lacer possesses the original ring connected to her father and asks Oliver to arrange a meeting with the Raven Queen.
in_short: Sebastien begins the term grieving Newton Moore and hiding that she is also Siobhan, the wanted Raven Queen. She deepens her study of light magic, works with Liza on a dangerous sleep-proxy spell, and joins Anna and Damien in a scheme that exposes Malcolm's corruption and secures Oliver Dryden's textile agreement. The Architects of Kronos attack the Verdant Stag and Knave Knoll to recover Siobhan's stolen book. Siobhan helps defeat the assault, though the prison is destroyed and her equipment is lost. Malcolm is arrested, Anna's position improves, and Sebastien gains a four-percent business share and financial independence. Yet renewed blood scrying, Red Guard manipulation of Newton's family, and the lethal costs of the sleep project remain unresolved. The book ends with Siobhan withholding trust from Oliver and deciding to investigate whether he used her crisis to conceal another secret, while Thaddeus Lacer holds the original ring tied to her father and seeks a meeting with the Raven Queen.

recaps.text: Previously: Siobhan entered Gilbratha carrying a stolen magical book and became wanted by the authorities. A transformation allowed her to attend the university as the male student Sebastien Siverling, where Thaddeus Lacer selected her as his apprentice. Outside the university, she became entangled with Oliver Dryden and the Verdant Stag, accumulating debt while building a formidable public reputation as the Raven Queen. Her effort to learn who was pursuing the stolen book drew in classmates Damien Westbay and Newton Moore, while Tanya Canelo served as a constrained link to the university faction behind the search. The conflict culminated in a rogue-magic disaster on Rafton Street. Newton died and became an aberrant, leaving Sebastien traumatized and magically prevented from explaining key events. The authorities retained blood that could be used to track her, the university still wanted the book, and the Verdant Stag remained both a source of protection and an obligation.

The Red Guard removes the two captured aberrants from Gilbratha while investigators debate whether the Raven Queen is an exceptional criminal or something more dangerous. Thaddeus Lacer studies the contradictions surrounding her identity and questions Siobhan's imprisoned father. The family history he hears suggests a possible inherited resistance to the mental dangers of blood-based casting, but it does not establish what the Raven Queen is. Sebastien wakes in the university infirmary exhausted and unable to discuss the disaster freely. She tells Damien that Newton Moore is dead, and Damien refuses to abandon their supposed secret organization. At Dryden Manor, Sebastien recovers enough to reaffirm her decision to pursue thaumaturgy despite the risk. Oliver reports that the Verdant Stag has taken over much of the Morrows' territory and warns of increased scrutiny. Sebastien then changes into Siobhan, confirming that both bodies belong to the same person and using that distinction to work around the vow imposed on Sebastien.

Sebastien returns to university as rumors turn her into a heroic survivor. Her friends support her, but Newton's death, Tanya's magical silence, and official interest in the Raven Queen remain constant pressures. Anna reveals that male relatives are trying to displace her as family heir and have threatened her younger sister Natalia. Sebastien also learns that a major exhibition will determine many of the contribution points she needs, prompting plans for a light-based display. Meanwhile, Oliver consolidates the Verdant Stag's control over former Morrow holdings and begins using legal claims, blackmail, and public evidence against abusive coppers. Photographer Percival Irving supplies him with an image of police violence and a distant picture of the Raven Queen, then accepts a role in Oliver's planned press operation. Siobhan obtains a stimulant to fight her dangerous exhaustion and discovers that a sealed fragment of Newton's aberrant form has remained caught in her clothing. She keeps it hidden. By the end of this span, Sebastien has ranked her main threats and makes neutralizing the authorities' blood sample a priority.

Siobhan hires Liza to help develop a sleep-proxy spell and gains access to protected casting facilities, anti-divination expertise, and new defensive equipment. Thaddeus tests Sebastien's supposed Raven Queen blessing but fails to discover her identity. He says he wants knowledge rather than a reward and asks Sebastien to convey an offer of contact to the Raven Queen. Sebastien also recognizes that her harsh judgment of Anna was unfair and begins repairing their friendship. Tanya approaches Oliver on behalf of university employers who want the stolen book and access to the Raven Queen. Oliver conceals Siobhan's location while considering a controlled meeting, but his legal textile project is blocked by Anna's family. Anna then offers a solution: if Sebastien helps remove her hostile uncles from the succession, Anna can secure the needed subcommission. Sebastien agrees to help plan the operation with Anna and Damien. She separately negotiates strong compensation from Oliver, including gold and a share of the future textile profits, giving the dangerous family scheme the potential to buy her independence.

Anna, Damien, and Sebastien design a vault operation intended to uncover real wrongdoing by Anna's uncles and later discredit them. The vault may also contain a ring tied to a coercive marriage agreement involving Siobhan's family. Outside the scheme, Siobhan's intervention in a street robbery expands the Raven Queen's reputation despite her rejection of worship and sacrifice. She warns an underground thaumaturge gathering that university agents may be hunting its members and acquires spells useful for bypassing locks and ciphers. Siobhan and Liza then begin live trials of the sleep-proxy spell. They use blood magic and vitality transfers to bind pairs of mice so that one remains awake while another bears the need for sleep. The initial subjects survive and behave as intended, but the result is only an early test. During the family operation, Sebastien and Damien enter Malcolm's office, move his warded vault within range of its key, and photograph records showing false accounts, embezzlement, and tax evasion. Sebastien replaces the stored ring with a forgery and takes the apparent original before the pair escapes undetected.

After the vault infiltration, Anna keeps Natalia away from Malcolm's household for the night. The group delays its next move while gathering corroboration, and Anna remains barred from seeing her sister except through their secretly linked journals. Sebastien's light magic advances rapidly, while her use of stimulant tincture produces increasing fatigue and headaches. Acting remotely as Chauvin, she negotiates with Grandmaster Kiernan's university faction over the stolen book. They give her a valuable censer as tribute, but a concealed attempt to locate her destroys the magical messenger and ends the meeting. Sebastien retains both the book and the tribute, and Oliver concludes that the faction acted in bad faith. The official account of Newton's death then portrays him as a corrupt practitioner and Sebastien as an innocent hero. Thaddeus explains how that story protects the university and Crown families by isolating the disaster from ordinary thaumaturgy. Sebastien realizes that public explanations of aberrance may be deliberately shaped, further weakening her trust in official narratives.

The ring taken from Malcolm's vault proves to contain a deliberately flawed false diamond rather than the expected solarium, leaving the genuine gem and the substitution unresolved. Tanya, frightened by her employers and the Raven Queen's reputation, asks to become Sebastien's discreet ally, but Sebastien gives no answer. Oliver learns that Kiernan's faction calls itself the Architects of Kronos and appears to be recruiting powerful help. He feeds Kiernan false dates for moving the captured Morrows while arranging an earlier transfer. Anna's operation stages a fraudulent meeting in which her uncles appear to bargain with the Raven Queen and then betray her. The investigators detect weaknesses in the performance, but Sebastien anonymously points Thaddeus toward the uncles' suspicious behavior. At the same time, Thaddeus begins teaching Sebastien techniques that move a spell's effect beyond its central array. Her first method remains tethered and vulnerable, yet it reveals remarkable potential. Oliver then orders Sebastien to assist the secret Morrow transfer under her Sylvia Nakai identity. At Knave Knoll, Healer Knitsen and Sebastien stabilize a prisoner during dangerous cursework just before an alarm announces an attack.

Masked attackers ambush Oliver's prisoner convoy with military weapons, disabling filters, a powerful shield, and air magic. Siobhan uses long-range refraction to conceal Gerard as he reaches and kills the enemy air thaumaturge. Oliver survives a devastating blast, but his horse is killed, the convoy is broken, and a second enemy force arrives by canal. Coppers close on the battle while simultaneous attacks strike Verdant Stag properties, convincing Oliver that the Architects of Kronos designed the prisoner assault as a diversion. An elderly thaumaturge then uses a vast war array to consume Knave Knoll with mind-altering parasites and transformed stone. Siobhan discovers that fire destroys the parasites and helps the trapped survivors organize an escape. Tanya intervenes when the attackers try to seize Siobhan's satchel. Siobhan abandons the bag and remotely triggers its disintegration mine, killing the elderly caster and nearby attackers at the cost of all her carried equipment. At the damaged Verdant Stag, Oliver confirms that the enemy stole decoys, gold, and the traceable censer, but failed to find the hidden vault containing the real book and Siobhan's bloodprint vow.

Anna completes Operation Defenestration by confronting Malcolm with evidence of his false accounts, embezzlement, tax evasion, and staged dealings with the Raven Queen. She has already sent copies to her father and the coppers, turning the confrontation into a public exposure rather than continued blackmail. Malcolm retreats to destroy records and attacks when Sebastien breaches his warded office. Sebastien defeats and disarms him while Damien shields Anna and she rescues partly burned evidence. The trio plants additional material supporting the succession case, restrains Malcolm, and gives investigators its prepared account. Anna makes clear that she engineered his fall and will act again if the consequences are insufficient. Her father accepts the evidence, recognizes Anna's political resolve, and treats Sebastien and Damien as her allies. Malcolm is arrested and immediately loses his ability to challenge Anna's position, though Randolph's legal outcome is not established.

Sebastien receives a battle-wand license from Thaddeus, abandons her addictive stimulant, and confronts the worsening results of the sleep-proxy research. The spell can keep one subject awake, but it prevents that subject from sleeping and severely harms the sleeper over time. An intelligent test subject dies, yet renewed blood scrying and a nightmare-driven collapse convince Sebastien to continue despite the moral cost. Liza offers an expensive countermeasure that cannot guarantee every blood sample will be destroyed. Sebastien then visits Newton's family and discovers that the Red Guard altered their memories to support the false claim that forbidden magic caused his death. Thaddeus accepts such manipulation as public control, badly damaging Sebastien's trust in him and the institution. Oliver secures the textile agreement, giving Sebastien a four-percent share and financial independence, while Katerine confirms that both copies of her bloodprint vow are destroyed. Siobhan nevertheless suspects Oliver used her stolen-book crisis to conceal another valuable secret. She leaves without confrontation and resolves to investigate independently. Finally, Thaddeus reveals to Oliver that he holds the original ring connected to Siobhan's father and offers it as tribute for a meeting with the Raven Queen.
